text.arabic_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَدْعُوكُمْ فَتَسْتَجِيبُونَ بِحَمْدِهِۦ وَتَظُنُّونَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا

baseline.text: O gün sizi çağıracak, siz de O'na hamd ederek cevap verecek ve ancak kısa bir süre kaldığınızı sanacaksınız.

findings.text: Tek çağrı dağılmış topluluğu cevaba geçirip aradaki zamanı küçültür; diriliş yalnız maddi yeniden kurma değil, seslenişle gerçekleşen karşılıklı bir toplanmadır.

activation_trace.role: The spoken call supplies the initiating address and directs the addressees toward the caller.
The return of speech supplies uptake, making the summoned population participants in a call-and-answer event.
Praise opposed to blame gives the answer its evaluative and vocal content.

changed_reading.after: Their resurrection is staged as a summons that becomes audible in their own answering praise.
changed_reading.before: They are raised and happen to praise.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence يَدْعُوكُمْ فَتَسْتَجِيبُونَ بِحَمْدِهِ binds divine call, human answer, and praise.
baseline_models.mechanism: A voiced summons elicits an immediate answering act whose medium or accompaniment is praise; the verse presents resurrection as address and uptake, not merely as relocation.

activation_trace.role: Conviction after an indication supports a forceful retrospective judgment once the summons has occurred.
Uncertain supposition keeps the duration claim perspectival rather than fixing it as an objective measurement.
Remaining in a place supplies the extended state now viewed retrospectively.
Littleness reduces the remembered residence in scale, worth, or both.

changed_reading.after: At the summons, their temporal horizon contracts so that the prior residence counts as little, with the exact interval left unresolved.
changed_reading.before: They report a literally short stay.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The clause وَتَظُنُّونَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا joins estimation, remaining, and littleness.
baseline_models.mechanism: The arrived day supplies a new temporal scale: a formerly extended residence is recollected or judged as slight, while ظن leaves both strong conviction and uncertain estimate live.

activation_trace.role: The call supplies the directional pull that initiates movement toward a new state.
A penetrating cut supplies the image of an answer opening what had been closed.
Traversing land supplies the answer with a passage-like movement across a boundary.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the response itself images the opened passage by which the summoned cross into manifest presence.
changed_reading.before: Responding is only a verbal reaction after revival.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjacency of يَدْعُوكُمْ and فَتَسْتَجِيبُونَ anchors a movement from call to answer in the focus construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside ordinary verbal reply, the answer-root carries cutting, traversing, and opening images; these render response as passage from one state into another.

activation_trace.role: The direct summons supplies the communication event that succeeds where prior address did not.
Verbal return supplies the decisive reversal from withdrawal to uptake.
Turning something through successive states supplies the repeated variation of present discourse.
Drawing away supplies the adverse result that the future answer reverses.
Turning the back supplies a bodily anti-response to the present mention of the one Lord.
Increase supplies the feedback loop in which warning amplifies rather than cures resistance.
Exceeding the limit in disobedience names what presently grows before the answering reversal.

changed_reading.after: The call belongs to a new communicative regime: present address can be resisted, but this summons becomes answer.
changed_reading.before: The call is another message that finally persuades them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeatedly varied discourse presently increases withdrawal, and singular mention produces turned backs; even warning later increases transgression. Against that failed communication loop, the one future call receives an answer, so 17:52 marks a change in the hearer's regime rather than one more persuasive formulation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated failed addresses and one successful call; I infer a change in receptivity or compulsion at the event, while the live alternative is that revival has already changed the hearers before the call.
structural_cues: 17:41 varies the Qur'an but yields more aversion; 17:46 mentions the Lord alone but yields turned backs; 17:60 warns but yields more transgression; 17:52 calls once and yields response.

activation_trace.role: Praise supplies the content that links the human answer to the wider praising field.
Declaring transcendence supplies the universal action within which praise operates.
The same praise branch and possessive construction provide the direct verbal bridge to 17:52.
Understanding supplies the presently missing capacity, making future voiced participation a changed relation to creation's praise.

changed_reading.after: Their answer brings human voices into the praise with which all things already glorify Him.
changed_reading.before: They individually thank God while answering.

context_deltas.mechanism: The identical بِحَمْدِهِ construction in 17:44 places praise inside the ongoing glorification of all things, which humans presently fail to comprehend. In 17:52 the summoned answer is therefore heard as human entry into a praise-response already voiced by creation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an identical praise phrase and a universal but uncomprehended chorus; I infer that the future answer joins that chorus, while the alternative is merely two independent uses of praise.
structural_cues: The exact phrase بِحَمْدِهِ occurs in both 17:44 and 17:52, while 17:44 explicitly contrasts universal glorification with human non-understanding.

activation_trace.role: The penetrating cut supplies the exploratory mechanism by which answer opens blocked access.
Prevention of access supplies the outer communication barrier.
A preserving cover supplies the enclosure over the heart that blocks comprehension.
Weight in the ear supplies the auditory resistance that the summons must overcome.

changed_reading.after: Their answer manifests the collapse or penetration of the very barriers that presently prevent hearing and understanding.
changed_reading.before: They hear normally and choose to answer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The local context layers denied access, protective coverings over hearts, and weight in ears. The focus answer-root's penetrating-cut image now gains a concrete obstruction: the successful answer is an opening through a previously closed auditory-cognitive system.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies layered barriers and the focus inventory supplies a penetrating answer-image; I infer that answering marks breached access, while the alternative is that the barriers are removed separately before any call occurs.
structural_cues: 17:45-46 moves from a barrier between hearer and recitation to covered hearts and weighted ears; 17:52 moves directly from call to answer.

activation_trace.role: The summons supplies the address through which the returned subjects are called into active relation.
Their reply supplies experiential proof that the disputed subjects are again present and capable of uptake.
Pulverization and debris supply the material condition claimed to make return impossible.
Stirring the still from rest supplies the resurrection process under dispute.
Return after departure frames the explicit question to which the focus event responds.
Origination supplies the stated capacity grounding the second creation.

changed_reading.after: The summons and their answer dramatize re-creation itself: the alleged debris is now an addressable, responsive population.
changed_reading.before: After bodies are independently rebuilt, God calls them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context poses fragmented remains against being raised and asks who can return them; it answers with the one who originated them. Then 17:52 presents that return as call and answer. The answering subjects are the enacted resolution of the disputed re-creation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the objection, the first-creation answer, and then responsive subjects; I infer that the effective address constitutes or completes their return, while the alternative is that re-creation is complete before the call.
structural_cues: 17:49 asks whether debris can be raised; 17:51 asks who will return us and answers with the first originator; 17:52 depicts those same addressees answering His call.

activation_trace.role: The focus call fixes God as initiating caller and humanity as the addressed party.
Praise gives the reversed relation its acknowledgment rather than another rival claim.
The command to call claimed powers supplies the prior, misdirected direction of address.
Removing a cover supplies the relief that the invoked parties do not control.
Transformation from one state supplies the further change those invoked parties cannot effect.
The repeated invocation identifies its supposed objects as seekers rather than ultimate callers.

changed_reading.after: It also reverses misdirected invocation: those who called elsewhere are exposed as dependents when the true caller summons them into praise.
changed_reading.before: The verse only describes efficient obedience at resurrection.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 17:56-57 humans invoke claimed powers that cannot uncover harm or transform it and that themselves seek nearness. In 17:52 the direction of invocation reverses: God is caller, humans are called, and their reply is His praise.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a grammatical reversal and the invoked parties' incapacity; I infer a relational correction in which the callers become the called, while the alternative is a simple change of scene without polemical carryover.
structural_cues: 17:56-57 repeatedly assigns humans the act of calling others; 17:52 reverses the grammar so that He calls them and they answer.

activation_trace.role: The day as a severe event supplies the threshold from which prior duration is reassessed.
Residence supplies the interval whose apparent magnitude collapses.
Littleness supplies the retrospective contraction produced at the threshold.
Temporal nearness supplies the anticipatory compression immediately before the focus day.
The repeated severe-day image identifies the local temporal horizon as the resurrection event.
Rising and resurrection name the event at which the temporal reassessment occurs.
An inscription that establishes judgment or decree supplies fixed appointment rather than vague futurity.
The written line makes the event's recorded fixity materially explicit.

changed_reading.after: The fixed and near Day becomes the scale-changing threshold on which any prior residence can be judged as little.
changed_reading.before: A short duration is simply reported.

context_deltas.mechanism: The event is called near, identified as the Day of Rising, and presented as fixed in an inscribed record. This appointed threshold reframes the focus estimate of a little stay: measured duration loses scale when the fixed day arrives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nearness, a named rising day, and written fixity; I infer that arrival at this threshold compresses remembered duration, while the live alternatives are earthly life, death's interval, or another residence as the thing deemed little.
structural_cues: 17:51 closes with عسى أن يكون قريبا; 17:52 opens with يوم; 17:58 repeats يوم القيامة and closes with في الكتاب مسطورا.

remaining_uncertainties: The referent and objective length of the stay remain deliberately unresolved.
The ظن branch permits both strong conviction from a new sign and fallible temporal estimation.
It is unclear whether the summons causes reconstitution, completes it, or addresses subjects already reconstituted.
The perforation, gathering, and kinetic readings are packet-backed branch activations but should remain exploratory rather than lexical substitutions.
strongest_changes: The future call is a regime change from repeatedly increased aversion to unavoidable or newly enabled answer.
The repeated بِحَمْدِهِ links the human answer to creation's already ongoing glorification.
The call-and-answer sequence enacts the answer to the local objection about returning fragmented remains.
The grammar reverses misdirected invocation: former callers become the called and answer with His praise.
The near, written Day acts as a threshold that compresses prior residence into littleness.
summary.what_was_special: The packet aligned an exact praise phrase, a dense sequence of failed hearing, an explicit who-will-return-us question, and a later reversal of the call relation around one compact focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: Gathering and obtaining supplies an exploratory image in which scattered persons are collected into one answering body.
Pulverized debris supplies the dispersed material pole that makes re-gathering mechanistically legible.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, answering images their collection from dispersal into a single responsive assembly.
changed_reading.before: Many already reconstituted individuals happen to answer together.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The split mapping from ج و ب to ج ب ي makes gathering a form-distant activation, not a lexical gloss of تستجيبون; it remains anchored in the packet's focus inventory and gains local force from the debris of 17:49, so downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb فَتَسْتَجِيبُونَ is the packet anchor for a non-dominant mapped branch of gathering and acquisition.

activation_trace.role: Remaining in a place supplies the static condition about to be reassessed.
Bearing, rising, and setting out supplies a kinetic undertone to the end of residence.
Instability and movement supply the dislodgement that contrasts with settled remaining.
Bodily standing supplies the nearby event-image that activates the focus word's rising branch.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its quantity sense carries a secondary tremor of being lifted from, and no longer stable in, the place of staying.
changed_reading.before: قليلا only quantifies how long they stayed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The carrying, rising, and instability branches are distant from the ordinary quantity sense of قليلا and must not replace it in translation; they remain focus-anchored and are reinforced by the nearby Day of Rising, so downstream prose may use them only as a secondary kinetic echo.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus opposition between لَّبِثْتُمْ, remaining in place, and قَلِيلًا, whose inventory also carries rising and instability, permits a kinetic undertone.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The final call cuts through delay and elicits an answering passage.** `د ع و:B001` calls near, `ج و ب:B001/B003/B004` pierces, answers, and opens a gap, `ل ب ث:B001/B002` stays and delays, and `ق ل ل:B001` makes little. Call and response compress the remembered interval. I infer irresistible recognition opens through temporal enclosure. Rising reads as responsive transit, with former duration retrospectively reduced.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:107–109 transforms the call into an answering fall before the final call: knowledgeable hearers already rehearse responsive rising through prostration.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The call cuts through duration and reorganizes it as response.** Lexical evidence: `د ع و B001` (calling to draw near by voice or speech) in `يَدْعُوكُمْ`, `ج و ب B001` (piercing or cutting through) together with `ج و ب B003` (answering and responding) in `فَتَسْتَجِيبُونَ`, and `ل ب ث B001` (staying in a place) in `لَّبِثْتُمْ`. Structural cue: 17:49–51 asks how dispersed or hardened beings return; one call is followed immediately by response and a judgment of little duration, while 17:53 regulates another consequential field of speech. Assigned role: calling draws the dispersed near, response pierces the separation, and remembered staying contracts after the transition. Abductive move: the ayah supplies call, answer, and changed temporal estimate; I infer that successful summons reorganizes both the group and its experience of elapsed time. Reading change: resurrection appears as responsive reassembly by address, not only material reconstruction.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:53 supplied a surprising analogue: speech can also reorganize a living group, but unlike the resurrection call it must be carefully chosen because the interval can be exploited for discord.

words.gloss_range: the accusative time-frame of the resurrection calling scene; locally an event-period rather than an ordinary date alone
words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمَ}} ({{tr:yawma}}) opens by making time the doorway into the whole scene. Its accusative adverbial role houses the call, response, praise, and later reckoning inside one decisive event-frame. The word still draws on the familiar idea of a bounded day, but the following call specifies it as the resurrection Day of summons, with same-surah calling echoes at 17:71 and a boundary handoff from the near timing question in 17:51.
